summary_en: Medipal Holdings authorized the acquisition of up to 4 million shares (2.0% of shares outstanding excluding treasury stock) for a maximum of 10 billion yen through market purchases from November 6, 2026 to March 31, 2027, with all acquired shares to be canceled by March 31, 2027.
title_en: Notice Regarding Resolution on Acquisition and Cancellation of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On October 23, 2026, Medipal Holdings' board of directors authorized a share buyback program to acquire up to 4 million shares (2.0% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock) for a maximum of 10 billion yen. The purchases will be executed through market transactions on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between November 6, 2026 and March 31, 2027. All acquired shares will be canceled by March 31, 2027.

The company stated that the buyback program reflects its policy of flexible capital management aimed at improving capital efficiency and enhancing shareholder returns. The company intends to fund the acquisition using proceeds from the sale of investment securities announced on the same date, along with other available funds. This initiative is positioned as part of the company's fundamental approach of comprehensively evaluating capital needs while balancing shareholder distributions with strategic investments.
